transforms.code:
# The range's waste entries (each waste counter's counter events with a value) and the runs in Production with waste but no
	# waste entries: their waste is infeed less outfeed (by package count), coded in full as one entry. Read again on tick
	params = value['value'] or {}
	assetId, start, end = params.get('assetId'), params.get('startDate'), params.get('endDate')
	empty = {'entries': [], 'derived': [], 'runs': [], 'units': '', 'counterId': None}
	if assetId is None or start is None or end is None: return empty
	now = system.date.now()
	upTo = now if system.date.isBefore(now, end) else end
	ok = lambda d: d is not None and not isinstance(d, basestring)
	entries, counterId = [], None
	counters = system.kanoa.asset.getCounter({'assetId': assetId, 'counterTypeName': 'waste'})
	for c in system.dataset.toPyDataSet(counters) if ok(counters) else []:
		if counterId is None: counterId = c['counterId']
		data = system.kanoa.event.getCounterEvents({'counterId': c['counterId'], 'startDate': start, 'endDate': upTo, 'hasValue': True})
		for e in system.dataset.toPyDataSet(data) if ok(data) else []:
			if e['tStamp'] is None: continue
			entries.append({'id': e['counterEventId'], 'counterId': e['counterId'], 't': system.date.toMillis(e['tStamp']), 'value': float(e['value'] or 0),
				'itemStateId': e['itemStateId'], 'reason': e['itemStateName'], 'category': e['itemStateClassName'], 'itemId': e['itemId'],
				'item': e['itemName'], 'workOrderId': e['workOrderId'], 'workOrder': e['workOrderName'], 'isCoProduct': bool(e['isCoProduct'])})
	entries.sort(key=lambda e: e['t'])
	runs, derived, units = [], [], ''
	data = system.kanoa.event.getAssetProductionEvents({'assetId': assetId, 'startDate': start, 'endDate': upTo, 'strictDates': True})
	for r in system.dataset.toPyDataSet(data) if ok(data) else []:
		if r['modeTypeName'] != 'Production' or r['startDate'] is None: continue
		units = units or r['wasteUnits'] or ''
		# The run's part of the range, as its counts are (strictDates)
		t0 = max(system.date.toMillis(r['startDate']), system.date.toMillis(start))
		t1 = min(system.date.toMillis(r['endDate']) if r['endDate'] is not None else system.date.toMillis(upTo), system.date.toMillis(upTo))
		run = {'t0': t0, 't1': t1, 'itemId': r['itemId'], 'item': r['itemName'], 'workOrderId': r['workOrderId'], 'workOrder': r['workOrderName']}
		runs.append(run)
		waste = float(r['wasteCount'] or 0)
		if waste > 0 and counterId is not None and not [e for e in entries if t0 <= e['t'] <= t1]:
			derived.append(dict(run, value=waste))
	runs.sort(key=lambda r: r['t0'])
	return {'entries': entries, 'derived': derived, 'runs': runs, 'units': units, 'counterId': counterId}

	if not value: return []
	data = system.kanoa.item.getAssetItemStates({'assetPath': value, 'enabled': True})
	options, seen = [], set()
	for r in system.dataset.toPyDataSet(data) if data is not None and not isinstance(data, basestring) else []:
		if r['itemStateId'] in seen or (r['counterTypeName'] and r['counterTypeName'] != 'waste'): continue
		seen.add(r['itemStateId'])
		options.append({'value': r['itemStateId'], 'label': '%s > %s' % (r['itemStateClassName'], r['itemStateName']) if r['itemStateClassName'] else r['itemStateName']})
	options.sort(key=lambda o: o['label'])
	return options

		system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'scrapEditor', 'type': 'warning', 'message': system.util.translate('Log in to change counts.', self.session.props.locale)})
		return

		'itemStateId': row['itemStateId'], 'itemId': row['itemId'], 'workOrderId': row['workOrderId'], 'tStamp': system.date.fromMillis(row['t0']),

transforms.code:
# A row for each group of waste entries with the same reason, item, work order and counter: by entry, 15 minutes, hour or
	# run (custom.group); and one for each run's uncoded waste with no waste entries. sel is the row's checkbox
	from java.text import SimpleDateFormat
	from java.util import TimeZone, Locale
	def dfmt(ms, pattern):
		# Month names in the session's language
		f = SimpleDateFormat(pattern, Locale.forLanguageTag(str(self.session.props.locale or 'en-US').replace('_', '-')))
		if value['tz']: f.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone(value['tz']))
		return f.format(system.date.fromMillis(ms))
	def span(a, b):
		if a == b: return dfmt(a, 'MMM d, HH:mm:ss')
		return '%s - %s' % (dfmt(a, 'MMM d, HH:mm'), dfmt(b, 'HH:mm' if dfmt(a, 'yyyyMMdd') == dfmt(b, 'yyyyMMdd') else 'MMM d, HH:mm'))
	data = value['data'] or {}
	group = value['group'] or '15 min'
	locale = self.session.props.locale
	uncoded = system.util.translate('Uncoded', locale)
	runs = data.get('runs') or []
	def bucket(e):
		if group == 'Entry': return e['id']
		if group == '15 min': return e['t'] // 900000
		if group == 'Hour': return e['t'] // 3600000
		for n, r in enumerate(runs):
			if r['t0'] <= e['t'] <= r['t1']: return n
		return -1
	groups, order = {}, []
	for e in data.get('entries') or []:
		key = (e['counterId'], e['itemStateId'], e['itemId'], e['workOrderId'], e['isCoProduct'], bucket(e))
		g = groups.get(key)
		if g is None:
			g = groups[key] = {'sel': False, 'kind': 'entries', 'ids': [], 'times': [], 'values': [], 't0': e['t'], 't1': e['t'], 'qty': 0.0,
				'counterId': e['counterId'], 'itemStateId': e['itemStateId'], 'itemId': e['itemId'], 'workOrderId': e['workOrderId'],
				'isCoProduct': e['isCoProduct'], 'reason': ('%s > %s' % (e['category'], e['reason']) if e['category'] else e['reason']) if e['itemStateId'] else uncoded,
				'item': e['item'] or '', 'workOrder': e['workOrder'] or ''}
			order.append(key)
		g['ids'].append(e['id']); g['times'].append(e['t']); g['values'].append(e['value'])
		g['qty'] += e['value']; g['t1'] = e['t']
	rows = []
	for key in order:
		g = groups[key]
		g['entries'] = len(g['ids'])
		g['time'] = span(g['t0'], g['t1'])
		g['qty'] = round(g['qty'], 3)
		rows.append(g)
	for r in data.get('derived') or []:
		rows.append({'sel': False, 'kind': 'derived', 'ids': [], 'times': [], 'values': [], 't0': r['t0'], 't1': r['t1'], 'qty': round(r['value'], 3),
			'counterId': data.get('counterId'), 'itemStateId': None, 'itemId': r['itemId'], 'workOrderId': r['workOrderId'], 'isCoProduct': False,
			'reason': system.util.translate('Uncoded (calculated)', locale), 'item': r['item'] or '', 'workOrder': r['workOrder'] or '',
			'entries': 0, 'time': span(r['t0'], r['t1'])})
	rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['t0'])
	return rows

customMethods.name: applyReason
customMethods.script:
# The selected rows get the reason (ddReason), or none (clear). A group of several entries is combined into one entry for its total at its last
	# entry's time, with the same item and work order (chkCombine, unless grouped by entry): its entries are deleted by counter,
	# reason, item and work order over its own time, so only them. Otherwise each entry keeps its time and gets the reason. A run's
	# uncoded waste is added as one entry a second before the run's end in the range
	# clear: Clear reason, the entries back to uncoded (a run's uncoded waste has no entries to clear)
	reason = None if clear else self.getChild('flxControls').getChild('ddReason').props.value
	rows = [r for r in self.getChild('tblScrap').props.data if r['sel'] and not (clear and r['kind'] == 'derived')]
	if (reason is None and not clear) or not rows: return
	# A guest has no Kanoa user id to record the change with (its write would fail): say to log in instead
	userId = self.view.custom.userId
	if not userId or userId <= 0:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'scrapEditor', 'type': 'warning', 'message': system.util.translate('Log in to change counts.', self.session.props.locale)})
		return
	group = self.view.custom.group
	combine = bool(self.getChild('flxControls').getChild('chkCombine').props.selected) and group != 'Entry'
	entries = (self.view.custom.data or {}).get('entries') or []
	updates = sum([r['entries'] for r in rows if r['kind'] == 'entries' and not (combine and r['entries'] > 1)])
	if updates > 500:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'scrapEditor', 'type': 'warning', 'message': system.util.translate('Too many entries to change one at a time: turn on Combine, or select fewer rows', self.session.props.locale)})
		return
	msgs = []
	def seconds(ms): return system.date.fromMillis((long(ms) // 1000) * 1000)
	for r in rows:
		if r['kind'] == 'derived':
			if r['counterId'] is None: continue
			n, msg = system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent({'counterId': r['counterId'], 'tStamp': seconds(r['t1'] - 1000), 'deltaValue': r['qty'],
				'itemStateId': reason, 'itemId': r['itemId'], 'workOrderId': r['workOrderId'], 'isCoProduct': False}, userId)
			if msg: msgs.append(msg)
			continue
		# Only this group's entries are in its time with its counter, reason, item and work order (a co-product entry would be too)
		same = [e for e in entries if r['t0'] <= e['t'] <= r['t1'] and e['counterId'] == r['counterId'] and e['itemStateId'] == r['itemStateId']
			and e['itemId'] == r['itemId'] and e['workOrderId'] == r['workOrderId']]
		if combine and r['entries'] > 1 and len(same) == r['entries']:
			n, msg = system.kanoa.event.deleteCounterEvents({'counterId': r['counterId'], 'startDate': system.date.fromMillis(r['t0']),
				'endDate': system.date.fromMillis(r['t1'] + 1), 'itemStateId': r['itemStateId'], 'itemId': r['itemId'], 'workOrderId': r['workOrderId']}, userId)
			if msg:
				msgs.append(msg)
				continue
			n, msg = system.kanoa.event.addCounterEvent({'counterId': r['counterId'], 'tStamp': system.date.fromMillis(r['t1']), 'deltaValue': r['qty'],
				'itemStateId': reason, 'itemId': r['itemId'], 'workOrderId': r['workOrderId'], 'isCoProduct': bool(r['isCoProduct'])}, userId)
			if msg: msgs.append(msg)
			continue
		for id, t, val in zip(r['ids'], r['times'], r['values']):
			result = system.kanoa.event.updateCounterEvent({'counterEventId': id, 'counterId': r['counterId'], 'deltaValue': val, 'itemStateId': reason,
				'itemId': r['itemId'], 'workOrderId': r['workOrderId'], 'tStamp': system.date.fromMillis(t), 'isCoProduct': bool(r['isCoProduct'])}, userId)
			try: msg = result[1]
			except: msg = None
			if msg: msgs.append(msg)
	self.done(msgs)

customMethods.script:
# After a change: Delete asks again next time, the entries again, the chart and its summary (refreshProductionData), and a toast for any failure
	self.view.custom.confirmDelete = False
